messages.subject: Project Skylark - Board meeting 12 November
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

Confirming the Halstead board meeting on Tuesday 12 November at 10:00 to approve the Caldera licence. Sarah and James will join by video. Board pack (advice note, v3 agreed form and FTO summary) will be circulated Monday.

Donna Bridges
Practice Assistant, Whitfield Carter LLP
